constraints: Bids only when confident about the artwork's value
agents.name: Agent A

constraints: Limits bids to 20% above current price
agents.goal: Achieve high returns through strategic bidding
agents.name: Agent B

constraints: Bids only if the artwork meets personal criteria
agents.goal: Acquire the artwork for personal collection
agents.name: Agent C

causes.hypothesis: Higher confidence in the artwork's value leads to higher bids
causes.name: Bidder Confidence

causes.hypothesis: Aggressive bidding strategies result in higher final prices
causes.name: Bidding Strategy

causes.hypothesis: Preference for the artwork's style increases willingness to pay
causes.name: Artistic Preference

interaction.stopping_rule: Auction ends when no further bids are placed

outcome.measurement_question: What is the final price paid for the artwork?
outcome.name: Final Bid Price
outcome.operationalization: The highest bid submitted by any agent during the auction

scenario: 3 bidders participating in an auction for a piece of art starting at fifty dollars
